name: Wick
description: a small bent damned soul with a lit white candle for a head, a steady pale green flame on top that never burns shorter, a worn grey hood around the candle, a ragged grey robe, holding a long wooden pole with a little wick at its tip

poses.stand: standing in profile facing right, candle-head flame steady pale green, holding a long wooden lighting pole
poses.walk: mid-stride walking to the right, lighting pole planted with each step, candle flame steady
poses.light: standing in profile facing right, reaching the tip of his lighting pole up to a lamp, pale green flame flaring at the tip
poses.talk: standing in profile facing right, candle-head flame bobbing as he speaks softly, pole resting, kind posture

idle.action: stands, candle flame flickers gently, shifts weight, pole tip dips slightly

walk.action: walks forward unhurried in place, feet plant cleanly with no slide, pole swings lightly, candle flame steady

hiccup.action: flinches back, startled, then settles and nods

lightLamp.action: reaches the pole tip up to light a lamp, pale green flare at the tip, then lowers the pole

talk.action: speaks softly, candle flame bobbing with each word, feet planted, kind and patient
